Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Stores excess kinetic energy in blade hydraulics and releases them all in one burst, allowing slashes from somewhat shocking distances.

Mantis Blade Cyberware Enhancement. This enhancement applies to two installations of Mantis Blades on separate arms when purchased, and does not count toward the amount of Cyberware Enhancements installed into either Mantis Blade. While Combat Software (Spatial Mapping) is installed, if the user has active and paired Jump Boosters or Reinforced Tendons and has made at least one successful attack during the previous 2 Rounds with Mantis Blades, Spatial Mapping is charged. Spatial Mapping may then be used at any time in the remaining combat encounter as a ROF 1 Attack Action.

When using Spatial Mapping, the user can leap up to 8m/yds directly towards a target that is within their line of sight, which does not consume any of the user’s MOVE or suffer any movement penalty. If the user gets within melee range of their target via Spatial Mapping, their next successful attack against the target with any Mantis Blade with this enhancement deals 2d6 additional damage (6d6), and if it would ablate the target’s armor, ablates 2 additional SP.

Enhances: Mantis Blade
Option Slots: 0 (Cyberware Enhancement)

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Cyberarms).
